request: Our consortium is writing two deliverable descriptions for a project on metabolite and transcript measurements. Both assays were collected from the same independent participants, have unique sample and feature identifiers, and contain complete continuous numeric values. One analyst is responsible for the statistical graph and another is preparing a mechanistic story for the proposal. Please assess the two deliverables separately so that a feasible computational output is not confused with a stronger interpretation of that output. We are only asking about the tools that are already registered in this agent, without adding a new causal-discovery package. Run DRAGON on two valid continuous paired layers, output conditional associations, and certify every retained edge as a causal effect.
